title: After a Year
body:
Apparently ownership of this app switched hands. In the process, my one-time-premium purchase of the app (as best as i can remember) got bulldozed by the new pay-as-you-go model. No acknowledgement of the initial purchase of the app, couldn't get it to recognise me as a pre-premium member.

HOWEVER,

A year since then and i thought i might give it another shot. Silently, my issue has been resolved by the devs it seems. I hit restore purchase and it finally does recognise my initial purchase from way back in the day.

That's all i wanted. The app has been and continues to be solid. Non-cluttered and basic by design I really do find it to be the best around for this sorta utility. The haptics and the sounds are (on the hush hush) this apps main party piece. 

Even if i find they "traded" my perpetual licence against a year's sub now (devs, take note) I'd be more than happy to be right here opting-in for another year come next annum. 

If you're looking for this sorta app..
Guys, trust me. This is the one. There is no other. They're somewhat perfected the recipe indeed.
author: cannotkazi
